mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmGrStockGrDetailPopList*/ SELECT PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY, PODT.AGENT_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE, PODT.ITEM_QTY * PODT.AGENT_PRICE AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT, PODT.BUYER, PODT.CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMPODT PODT WHERE PODT.BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ

/*selectMasterWmGrStockGrDetailVMIPopList*/ SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO AS STDCATLG_ID, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ITEM_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY * UNIT_PRICE AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT, BUYER, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ FROM EDIVPODT EDI WHERE BUYER =#{ware_house_code} AND VPO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND STATUS ^='D'
